note: No host. Nothing maps a room to its host, so the caller must name it.
A host that is not a DID. The recipient resolves the host as a DID and speaks only the transports its document advertises; a URL would be an address the caller chose.
A record key. The caller cannot know where the profile is — that is the point — so it cannot name one.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
An unknown status. `found`, `absent` and `cleared` are three different sentences to a member; a fourth would be one no surface knows how to say.
A profile with no name. A room's profile always names it.
A rejection with a reason the specification does not define.
